blocks.raw:
<Tip>
**"Exit width = OL × 7.6, then distribute across required exits, each ≥ 900mm."** Never under-size an individual exit. If calculated width doesn't distribute evenly, round up and provide larger exits.
</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["ERR-DSGN-019: Using 5mm per person instead of 7.6mm for exit width","ERR-DSGN-020: Using 30m travel distance instead of 45m (unsprinklered) or 60m (sprinklered)","ERR-DSGN-021: Assuming 1 exit serves 100 persons; correct max is 49 persons","ERR-DSGN-024: Using 10m dead-end limit instead of 6m (unsprinklered) or 12m (sprinklered)","Calculating exit width but forgetting 900mm minimum per exit","Not separating occupancy loads by use type (e.g., treating dining + kitchen as one load)","Placing all exits on one side of floor; far side becomes dead-end beyond limit","Using wrong load factors (e.g., assembly 9.3 instead of 0.65-1.1)"]} />
